profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Zoom
profile.summary: I'm constantly searching for an opportunity for growth to further develop my skills and to bring excellence to any establishment I become apart of.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enabled reactive automated platform security by developing machine learning models utilizing AWS Sagemaker and Databricks, resulting in enhanced platform safety for users by predicting bad actors during login
▪ Built ETL/Data pipelines using Apache Airflow, Databricks Workflows, and AWS Kinesis to prepare data for training ML models
▪ Created scalable event-driven backend microservices with SpringBoot hosted in AWS which proactively prevents and mitigates “Account Takeovers” for over 400k zoom users a year
▪ Developed full-stack applications utilizing React and Python to create platforms used internally for automation, monitoring trending data for application vulnerability management, and various metrics to monitor data quality, enhancing process efficiency
▪ Formulated comprehensive High-Level and Detailed Design documents, laying a clear blueprint for strategic future developments
▪ Performed the role of Security Champion, remediating vulnerabilities found in micro-services within the SLA

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
▪ Utilized Spring Framework and Spring integration to develop Event-Driven Microservices
▪ Integrated microservices with JPA to feed into ORACLE DB, enabling seamless data flow
▪ Ensured high code coverage by writing Junit tests, cucumber alongside TDD and BDD resulting in more reliable code
▪ Created RESTFUL APIs that scale to high loads/volume, improving system performance under high traffic
▪ Built and deployed pipelines for CI/CD integration for Pivotal Cloud Foundry platform, streamlining deployment process
▪ Created High Level Design and Detail Designs to be implemented during sprints (Agile biweekly sprint), providing clear plans for implementation
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) and +15 skills
